title: Polynomial identity from infinitely many equal evaluations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain, meaning a nonzero commutative ring with no zero divisors, and let $p,q\in R[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. If the set $\{a\in R:p(a)=q(a)\}$ is infinite, then $p=q$ as polynomials.
